description: Conditional evaluation of source-qualified solver variants on registered Main split, with same-run R69 and three frozen Tri-SIG-TIME readers.
authorization: Active LoRa and WiSig restoration research goal, single-seed source qualification.

code.commit: Committed evaluator verified by immutable release at publication
code.environment: N607 fixed forced-WiSig archive Python; pinned native FIR modules for the trained candidate

data.version: Registered WiSig Main split, cross_rx and cross_both
data.representation: Native float32 [2,256], 25 MS/s, paired full and residual source panel
data.contract_ref: Original frozen WiSig Main split native post_sync/noeq view handles
data.physical_ids_ref: Independent disjoint per-split Main physical ID lists in original manifests
data.label_map_ref: Three frozen Tri-SIG-TIME shared class ordering, independently checked against truth side
data.validation_ref: Fixed prior blind replay order, fresh raw parity, and full case/view closures

permissions.claim_scope: Locked-key comparisons for cross_rx 126000, cross_both 42000 and disjoint union 168000, two routes. Only independent scorer accesses target labels.

checkpoint.initialization: Exact step-40000 weights from one qualified training seed

sources.role: Both arms may qualify independently. One frozen G per arm shared between routes.
Frozen original R69, rerun on the same packets inside each job.
Same three frozen official Tri-SIG-TIME readers.
Paired blind raw verification and observational rerun drift reporting.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: qualified_spectral, reference runtime, strict source-only checkpoint loader and real source smoke
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Training provenance fixed by registered source run with source-only IQ. No inherited R69 or F in training.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Admit each source arm only if both source routes strictly beat R69 six scenes and retain the R69 clean correct counts. No target feedback.

execution.gpu_policy: At most two concurrent case workers on independently eligible GPUs; retain all current healthy jobs.
execution.stop_rule: A failed source scientific rule closes the case before target IQ. Technical stop for bind/smoke/finite/IQ order/raw parity or closure failures. Preserve partial artifacts.

metric_names: Macro F1 for each frozen reader
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: wisig_r69_main_recheck score in separate CPU worker after four blind shards close

rows.seed_notes: Model seed identifies the trained restorer. Evaluation uses the three separately listed frozen reader seeds, not three refits of the restorer.
